description:
Data and analysis code accompanying the manuscript "Thickness-dependent secondary-electron emission from suspended MoS2 membranes in the helium ion microscope" (C. Kim, D. Lister, P. Jackle, and K. L. Kavanagh), revised for Applied Physics Letters.

The repository contains the raw HIM images (transmission, backside-blocked, and copper-tape converter series), ROI intensity tables and extraction scripts, Bayesian carbon-reference normalization, SE-escape model comparisons, sensitivity analyses, SRIM inputs, and transmitted-ion trajectory analyses.

Version 1.1.0 adds revision/, containing the analysis scripts and outputs for the revised manuscript: model refits using the thickness-dependent SRIM ionization profile, the updated Fig. 3, supplementary sensitivity checks, and acquisition metadata summaries. All version 1.0.0 files remain unchanged so that the originally submitted analysis is preserved. See revision/README.md for details.

The full SRIM transmitted-ion campaign archive (mos2-30keV-srim-transmitted-ion-campaign.zip, 440 MB) is attached to GitHub release v1.0.0 of the repository.
